snippet_primary: "On Wednesday morning, while brewing coffee, an alert pops up - Payhip notifies me. A customer signed up for the monthly package costing forty-nine bucks. I honestly believed it was junk mail or some trial charge I'd overlooked. Looked into it again - twice more - to be sure. Nope. Actual buyer. Seems they arrived via SaaSHub, judging by the ref link - though truthfully, I can't say for certain; Payhip's logs aren't that clear."
